title: Boxwood folding rule
summary: A two-foot folding rule with brass hinges, carried by carpenters along the river yards.
body: A common tool made uncommon by the owner's scratched initials on the end cap.
label_text: Boxwood folding rule. Elias Wren, Rookwater, about 1912. Boxwood and brass. Gift of the Wren family.

title: Machinist's calipers
summary: Outside calipers stamped with a Rookwater forge mark, used in the mill repair shop.
body: The points still show wear from measuring shaft diameters.
label_text: Machinist's calipers. Rookwater forge, 1924. Steel. Museum purchase.

title: Chalk line reel
summary: A chalk line reel with original blue chalk still in the cup.
body: Used for Saturday demos in The Measured Hand.
label_text: Chalk line reel. Maker unknown, about 1938. Hardwood, cotton, chalk. Gift of Millrace Works.

title: Bevel gauge
credit: Gift of the Helderwyn Shop estate
summary: A rosewood bevel gauge from the museum's namesake workshop, founded (story) in 1884.
body: The brass blade locks with a wingnut that still turns smoothly.
label_text: Bevel gauge. Helderwyn Shop, 1951. Rosewood and brass. Gift of the estate.

title: Floor loom sample
summary: A scale model of a floor loom with a wool sample still on the beam.
body: Shown in Warp and Weather beside the working loom.
label_text: Floor loom sample. Rookwater Mill No. 2, 1899. Oak and wool. County archive transfer.

title: Indigo dye pot
summary: A stoneware indigo pot from the mill dye house, still stained at the rim.
body: Handled with gloves; the stain is part of the object.
label_text: Indigo dye pot. Mill dye house, about 1918. Glazed stoneware. Gift of the dye-house guild.

title: Pattern book, volume III
summary: A bound pattern book of mill weaves, annotated in pencil by the compiler.
body: Open to a twill page in the Textile Wing case.
label_text: Pattern book, volume III. Ada Pell, 1946. Paper and cloth. Gift of the family.

title: Cutaway kiln model
summary: A cutaway model of a bottle kiln used to explain firing to school groups.
label_text: Cutaway kiln model. Reconstruction after a 1904 plan. Wood and plaster. Museum fabrication.

title: Vinegar jug
credit: Gift of the barge museum exchange, 2005
summary: A salt-glazed jug stamped for river vinegar trade.
body: One of a set; two others are in storage.
label_text: Vinegar jug. Rookwater Pottery, 1929. Salt-glazed stoneware. Exchange gift.

title: Plaster mold, cup
summary: A two-part plaster mold for a handleless cup, used in school clay talks.
body: Kids may touch a replica; this mold stays behind glass.
label_text: Plaster mold for a cup. Studio, 1962. Plaster. Studio transfer.

title: Chairmaker's jig
summary: A jig for boring chair-leg angles, installed for Open Bench.
body: The maker uses it Thursday through Saturday.
label_text: Chairmaker's jig. Tov Ren, 2024. Maple and steel. Loan from the maker.

title: Pattern knife set
summary: A rolled set of pattern knives for cutting cloth markers in the Workshop Gallery.
body: Labeled do-not-touch; demos use a second set.
label_text: Pattern knife set. Mira Solen, 2024. Steel and walnut. Loan from the maker.

title: Forged nail header
summary: A nail header forged on site during Open Bench weekends.
body: Hot work happens outdoors under the west awning.
label_text: Forged nail header. Cal Orth, 2025. Iron. Loan from the maker.

title: Apprentice practice plane
credit: Gift of the apprenticeship ledger project
summary: A practice plane with uneven mouth, kept as a teaching object for the upcoming School of the Hand.
label_text: Apprentice practice plane. Maker unsigned, about 1888. Beech. Gift of the ledger project.

title: First owned chisel
summary: A chisel given to an apprentice at the end of the first year, according to the family note.
body: Will join School of the Hand.
label_text: Chisel. Marked J.H., 1910. Steel and ash. Gift of the Havel family.

title: Packing crate stamp
credit: Archive transfer after River Packing closed
summary: A carved stamp for marking crates. The show is closed; the stamp is in the Study Vault.
body: Members can request it at the vault desk.
label_text: Packing crate stamp. River Packing Co., 1933. Hardwood. Archive transfer.
